item.title: A Deep Dive into Kubernetes Network Packet Forwarding
item.description: This article is translated from https://learnk8s.io/kubernetes-network-packets, not word for word, with some of my own understanding worked in. item.description: 1. item.title: Kubernetes Networking
item.description: 1. Docker’s Network Model 1.1 bridge Mode bridge mode is used by default, and you can also specify it with --net=bridge. In bridge mode, containers connect to the same virtual bridge, docker0. docker0 usually occupies the 172.17.0.1/16 subnet. Containers on the same bridge can communicate directly over IP. 1.2 host Mode Use --net=host to specify host mode.
